summary: The P3/P4 sequence matches real native/domain gates and correctly includes the extra qualification dispatch reservation. It is a usable architecture for a future bounded helper. It is not a ready-to-run LIVE plan: the gateway UPPER_BOUND basis is unproved, T08/provider source acceptance and actual host/actor/evidence prerequisites are not yet satisfied. These holds are explicit and must not be replaced by acceptance labels.

verified_design.fact: ServeNative installs real Windows folder chooser after native peer/SID checks; a caller requested_path is only a hint. Native selection carries host/client/access/expiry and single-use redemption. Workspace.register and project.bootstrap may use that exact selection; no no-op chooser or fixture identity can authorize the path.
verified_design.condition: Use an owned new finite folder containing only evidence.txt, with genuine READ_ONLY choice. Its future creation/population must be inside the registered helper/evidence scope before selection. Do not scan or grant arbitrary existing user workspaces.

verified_design.fact: The supplied resource root is the data root. The actual existing DB is dataRoot/researchos.sqlite and Host.Config.Dir is dataRoot/host. ModelCredential checks provider opencode-go, nonrevoked exact credential ref and ref==revision before protected opening.
verified_design.condition: Helper must preserve these exact relative locations and original instance, not treat dataRoot itself as Host.Config.Dir or copy/reimport Vault. Before any domain.New/bootstrap call, separately approved same-source schema/backup preflight must determine actual installed schema/additive tables under the lease without silently upgrading. No SQL23 binary opens this resource before its upgrade/backup gates close.

verified_design.fact: RegisterRuntimeQualificationPlan is a real trusted local OWNER operation on a dependency-free draft with sealed current profile, task hash and owner root. BeginRuntimeQualification binds exact original Run/epoch/plan/profile/contract/input/context. Acceptance service recomputes NOT_RUN checks; qualifyRuntime requires an independently accepted exact Task, native settled observation, reconciled effects, current inputs/permissions and real verifier root distinct from author and executor. supports_resume=false is appropriate.
verified_design.condition: Real P3 output and original native proof precede any acceptance. Post /acceptances then /runtimes/{id}/qualify must be sent by actual independent verifier authority, not the executor with another nominal ID or a helper-authored PASS. Ordinary purpose authorization and P4 are held until those actual operations succeed.

verified_design.fact: ProvisionPrincipal/IssueCredential are real trusted local operations, not public APIs. authorityRoot defaults to principal ID if no lineage row, so different IDs alone can satisfy a weak caller assumption without proving real actor independence. RegisterExecutionIdentity binds delegated aliases before execution and must reflect real authority.
verified_design.condition: Future helper freezes public actual actor-to-principal/grant/lineage mapping and controlled credential delivery, with Root-owned provisioning separately registered. Use RegisterExecutionIdentity where delegation exists; do not invent extra roots. Executor must not receive independent verifier credential. IssueCredential TTL<=15minutes; phase changes may require new protected credentials for the SAME original principals, never fresh Run/effect/profile to work around expiration or UNKNOWN.

verified_design.fact: sessionModel requires one exact model_config_ref/runtime/command binding. AdmitTurn checks actual current qualified permission. Host read tool enforces real authorized root, canonical relative path, frozen allowlist and byte limit. Single evidence.txt, one read tool, no write/edit/run_check, zero monetary TOOL route and no endpoint/credential are compatible.
verified_design.condition: The TOOL provider route ID must equal the frozen model_config.route as current providerRoute requires; use separate capability/purpose entries, not an invented unrelated tool ID. Freeze a public witness unknown to the prompt, exact file bytes/hash and real read result. Require one original Task/Run MODEL->TOOL->MODEL and actual next-request consumption of full original reasoning/tool facts. Missing TOOL or second MODEL remains PARTIAL; no second prompt/Run or synthetic tool response can repair it.

verified_design.fact: Current Mu dispatch max is900seconds, not generic300. Proposed420 seconds is within it; AppContainer no capabilities/network, process1/memory256 and bounded outputs match current validator. P3 MODEL-only gate remains active even though the identical future P4 profile advertises a read tool.
verified_design.condition: If P3 model requests TOOL, record genuine refusal and do not retry with altered profile or turn thinking off. Unknown high-reasoning/provider support is a real qualification result.

budget_review.valid_findings: ReleaseQualificationReservation concerns only qualification-dispatch/{run}; its0 ACTUAL release is not MODEL money=0. MODEL actual_cost remains null and its original UPPER_BOUND RESERVE persists. The ledger may admit P4 with those finite outstanding reserves. Distinguish this from an actual UNKNOWN ledger entry, which STRICT/unknown BLOCK rejects. An UNKNOWN effect is a separate stop condition regardless of remaining known upper reserve.
budget_review.policy_freeze: Prefer a preinstalled reviewed project/global ancestor cap3.00 and actual per-call0.50 + P3max2/P4max4. P3 Goal must permit its2.00 peak. Freeze actual policy IDs/revisions/currency/window and prior liabilities. Any P4 Goal-specific policy change must happen before scan/claim and legitimate context revalidation; no racing READY task policy update. Child caps are not summed as extra authority.

unresolved_blocker.fact: The official native DeepSeek source identifies1M context and Go pricing/model ID supports an inference of the same model. It does not prove the gateway enforced maximum or all billable inputs. Request48KiB is bytes, not tokens. 0.3244032USD arithmetic and0.50 margin are a reasonable estimate, not independently established gateway UPPER_BOUND.
unresolved_blocker.impact: Current STRICT policy rejects ESTIMATE and UNKNOWN. Merely serializing cost_basis=UPPER_BOUND or retaining source citations cannot promote the unproven estimate. Existing resource GET/POST200 and user resource-intake authorization do not close this gate.
unresolved_blocker.required_resolution: Before paid phase, produce a separately reviewed exact reserve basis that establishes an enforceable request/output/pricing bound for this gateway or another explicitly accepted bounded provider billing mechanism. Freeze its assumptions and source refs with actual routes/policy. Do not silently loosen STRICT, mark actual_cost ACTUAL, inflate an arbitrary bound, or claim1M was returned by the authenticated Go catalog.

helper_source_review_conditions: Future helper must have an exact registered new receipt-source scope and independent source review before execution. This plan neither authorizes implementation nor opens the Host.

Freeze final integrated T08+provider9+CLI source vector, Node/Go/SDK/src/dist/build closure, fresh bundle and actual executable; references to current preintegration snapshot cannot qualify future execution.

Build complete actual profile fields including runtime_id, technical_hash, credential_revision, effect_routes and immutable model_config ref. Placeholder strings are plan placeholders only. Profile hash, current RuntimeRegistration, route purpose/mode/bounds and protected provider ref must agree.

One real lease, one coordinator and one server/native listener; hold automatic Scan until phase-specific admission inputs/budgets are frozen. RunAdmitted uses only BeginRuntimeQualification returned original run/lease. No second apps/control process on same root.

Persist phase mutation command IDs and exact public payload hashes before sending. Distinguish safe same-command canonical replay from forbidden UNKNOWN effect/provider re-dispatch. A process restart must first reconcile the same original states and refuse relaunch if unresolved.

P3 execution helper cannot accept itself. Independent actual actor reviews current original graph then uses its own short-lived protected credential at existing public acceptance/qualify interface. Root records actual delivery and approval, not a fabricated helper result.

Protected evidence projection requires its own exact table/column/public-content allowlist, source-current extraction recipe, coherent transaction/closed snapshot and original row/ref/digest graph. Do not publish a full Host/Vault DB. A caller-supplied projection label or sanitization claim is not provenance; missing scope blocks final verification.

Local causal fixture tests establish mechanism; real provider may emit different chunk counts. LIVE evidence must bind actual original SSE/SDK sequence->durable observation->compiled CLI arrival and final proof, without manufacturing40 frames or splitting a completed response.
Keep old source/attempt/raw/review versions and all P3/P4 refused prefixes. No runtime fallback, newmodel substitution, credential rebinding, thinking-off retry or old W14 UNKNOWN retry.
